title: MemoryImportsActivateRequest
description: Activate a staged import: all staged subjects/records/candidates/profiles/reflections/receipt-summaries become visible with fresh target revisions in one transaction, or none do. Activation increments the space authority_generation (§12.5). Grant: transfer plus admin. Mutating op: requires idempotency_key (§7.0.5) and returns a MemoryReceipt whose result is a content-free summary (§7.0.2).

idempotency_key.description: Caller-chosen, 1–128 characters (§6.1); unique within the dedup namespace (space_id, requester_principal_id, op, idempotency_key) (§7.0.5).
